item.text:
This continuation added no new independent defect category, but strengthened and completed several checks:

- The persistent-storage failure also affects the direct `append_entries` path used by core batching, not just `write_atomically`.
- A 5,000-step randomized crash/restart run completed 18 crashes and 2,488 proposals with no decided-index conflict; all five nodes converged.
- Default `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` passes.
- All 24 shipped runtime tests pass under `--all-features`.
- The LFU finding remains correctly scoped to the leader-cache-clone-to-follower path; a separate single-cache diagnostic that did not model protocol usage was discarded.

The audit still contains 16 confirmed findings, with the highest-impact being delta-snapshot corruption, LFU cache value corruption, and leaked persistent atomic writes. The updated report and retained evidence are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
